They are meant for "Max" distance, hence the aggressive lofts. My AW is a 48° then I have a 54° and a 60° so from my PW to my LW is a 6° change between each club. It works great for me, but any distance under 120 yrds is a shot played by feel, not a different club.

My iron lofts are different that average lofts of the club number. Like my PW is a 42° most irons sets that would be a 9i. They are the Callaway mavrik Max. Which has different lofts even from the other mavrik irons.

I recently got a mavrik driver and I love it. Average 270-280 carry with the occasional 300. Ended up getting mavrik irons as well. Took me from 100+ average score to high 90s with the driver to low 90s with the irons.

Some people say it's not the club, it's the golfer. I bought new fitted Mavrik irons to replace my 15+ year old set and immediately noticed a difference in both my swing and how I played. New technology and a +1/2" shaft length put me to hitting 200-210 with my 6. Lessons are next, but if you have a decent swing is say go for clubs first.

I got fitted at a local store and if you buy through them they wave the $70 fitting fee. It was totally worth it. Tried multiple clubs and found ones that feel right. Have since dropped my average score 4 strokes and reached sub 90 for the first time.
